event: FOMC minutes Wed 18 Nov at 21:00 SAST (time UNVERIFIED). October retail sales came out today at 15:30 SAST.

bullets.title: Gave back gains
bullets.text: Kitco showed spot gold at 3,858.00 bid at 14:57 SAST, up only 2.50 on the day, after an early high of 3,887.60.

bullets.title: Retail sales in line
bullets.text: Forex Fundamentals lists October retail sales at +0.2%, matching the forecast, after +0.8% (single source, so UNVERIFIED); gold's reaction after 15:30 SAST is not yet confirmed.

bullets.title: Prices disagree
bullets.text: Trading Economics showed 3,854-3,857 at an unstated time, so the exact price is UNVERIFIED within about 3,854-3,860.

bullets.title: Near 13-month low
bullets.text: Gold is still close to Monday's 3,832 low, its lowest since about October 2025 (TradingKey, FXEmpire).

bullets.title: Hike nearly priced
bullets.text: Markets price about 95.7% odds of a December quarter-point hike, with the rest on a half-point hike (Centrino, RoboForex).

bullets.title: Dollar and yields
bullets.text: The dollar index is about 103.66, a 19-month high, and the US 10-year yield about 5.12%, which keeps pressure on gold (Trading Economics, Centrino).

bullets.title: FOMC minutes next
bullets.text: Wednesday's FOMC minutes at 21:00 SAST (UNVERIFIED) can move gold fast if they sound more hawkish.

levels.note: RoboForex 3,915; Mitrade 3,920-3,930; TradingKey 3,920 where the last bounce stalled
